lesson_title: Internal Control: The Tuck Shop That Lost Its Float
hook_text: The float is short. Sipho did EVERYTHING. Is he a thief? Nobody can ever know — and that's the real problem.
clip_script: By Friday, the float is short. Is Sipho a thief? Probably not — but here is the uncomfortable truth: nobody can know. Not even Sipho. Money went into a pocket that also held his own money; sales lived in his memory; nobody counted anything at the start or the end. If he took nothing, he cannot prove it. If he took everything, nobody could prove that either. Now replay the week with three small changes. Ayanda takes the money. Sipho hands over the stock. Lerato ticks every sale in a notebook, and at closing, Ayanda and Lerato count the box together. Same learners, same chips — and when the box balances, his honesty is provable.
visual_style: School-corridor skit style: one overwhelmed learner juggling chips, coins and a notebook, then the replay with three learners and a cash box that snaps shut on a green tick.
mood: Relatable, a little tense, resolving into fairness.
pacing: Quick chaos montage, dead stop on 'nobody can know', calm rebuilt replay.
